response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as record_count, AVG(rebrate / feerate) as avg_rebate_fee_ratio FROM fees WHERE feerate >= 0.0009 AND rebrate IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: "Such fee records" refers to records used in the average calculation (where rebrate is not NULL), not all records where feerate >= 0.0009.

alternatives.interpretation: "Such fee records" refers to all records where feerate >= 0.0009 (the universe established at the start), and "ignoring missing values" applies only to the average calculation, not the count.
